an7.64:1.1: bhikkhave dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
an7.64:1.3: Idha bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:1.6: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa vaṇṇavatāya nandati.
an7.64:1.7: Kodhano 'yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ cāpi so hoti sunahāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu odātavatthavasano,
an7.64:1.8: atha kho so dubbaṇṇo ca hoti kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:1.9: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 3.
an7.64:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:2.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa sukhaseyyāya nandati.
an7.64:2.5: Kodhano 'yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ cāpi so pallaṅke seti gonakatthate paṭikatthate paṭalikatthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sa-uttaracchade ubhato-lohitakūpadhāne,
an7.64:2.6: atha kho so dukkhaṃ yeva seti kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:2.7: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 4.
an7.64:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:3.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa pacuratthatāya nandati.
an7.64:3.5: Kodhano 'yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto anatthaṃ pi gahetvā ‘attho me gahito' ti maññati, atthaṃ pi gahetvā ‘anattho me gahito' ti maññati.
an7.64:3.6: Tass' ime dhammā aññam aññavipaccanīkā gahitā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti kodhābhibhūtassa.
an7.64:3.7: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 5.
an7.64:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:4.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa bhogavatāya nandati.
an7.64:4.5: Kodhanassa bhikkhave purisapuggalassa kodhābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye pi 'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodhābhibhūtassa.
an7.64:4.6: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 6.
an7.64:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:5.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa yasavatāya nandati.
an7.64:5.5: Kodhano 'yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, yo pi 'ssa so hoti yaso appamādādhigato, tamhā pi dhaṃsati kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:5.6: Ayam bhikkhave pañcamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 7.
an7.64:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:6.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.
an7.64:6.5: Kodhanaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalaṃ kodhābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, ye pi 'ssa te honti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, te pi ārakā parivajjenti kodhābhibhūtaṃ.
an7.64:6.6: Ayaṃ bhikkhave chaṭṭho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. 8.
an7.64:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati
an7.64:7.2: ‘aho vatāyaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā' ti.
an7.64:7.4: Na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa sugatigamanena nandati.
an7.64:7.5: Kodhano 'yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an7.64:7.7: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:7.8: Ayaṃ bhikkhave sattamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
an7.64:8.1: Ime kho bhikkhave satta dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanam āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ti.
